title: GitHub Artifact Attestations：檔案摘要與工作流程來源關聯
titleEn: GitHub artifact attestations: binding local bytes to workflow provenance
subcategoryTitle: 可重現建置與產物准入
summary: 建立15份本地產物及合成證明描述，列SHA-256、來源repo、commit與workflow；將同名不同內容、fork來源及錯workflow列為負例。
summaryEn: Build 15 local artifact/provenance descriptors with SHA-256, source repository, commit and workflow. Include equal names with different contents, fork origins and unexpected workflows, keeping repository ownership distinct from mere filename resemblance.
scope: 本課採用原創合成工作負載或事件資料，在紙面、試算表與離線模型中實作。來源用於查證具名案例；數值、擾動與驗收門檻是教學假設，不是實機效能或正式環境變更規格。實驗限自己的或明確授權的隔離環境，交付可重算的證據紀錄。
scopeEn: Use original synthetic workloads or event data in paper, spreadsheet, and offline-model investigations. References establish named case context; numerical inputs, perturbations, and limits are teaching assumptions, not measured machine performance or production change specifications. Use owned or explicitly authorized isolated environments and deliver reproducible evidence records.

knowledge.textEn: GitHub artifact attestations provide provenance and build context. Connect downloaded bytes, subject digest, repository and workflow identity without treating the existence of an attestation as a guarantee that the software is vulnerability-free or suitable for deployment.

knowledge.title: 可驗證的工程目標
knowledge.text: 建立15份本地產物及合成證明描述，列SHA-256、來源repo、commit與workflow；將同名不同內容、fork來源及錯workflow列為負例。
knowledge.textEn: Build 15 local artifact/provenance descriptors with SHA-256, source repository, commit and workflow. Include equal names with different contents, fork origins and unexpected workflows, keeping repository ownership distinct from mere filename resemblance.

knowledge.title: 模型、介面與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 本地發布政策要求位元組摘要與subject一致，且來源repo/workflow符合核准契約；公開與私人repo的Sigstore實例及透明度特性不同，不能假設全部都有公開日誌。
knowledge.textEn: The local release policy requires matching artifact and subject digests plus approved repository/workflow provenance. Public and private repository attestation paths have different Sigstore transparency characteristics, so do not assume every attestation is backed by the public log.
